hypothesis: Original H5/E00: compare structure alone, structure plus scale, and scale alone at equal K; audit unit, future, metadata and legacy encoding effects.
sensitivity_method: ward, train linkage and nearest training-centroid assignment outside train
feature_window: 2023 only; 2024 mutated for future invariance; 2025 outcomes never input
canonical_features: mean monthly five-category value / same-month All categories; log1p mean total in original rubles
legacy_features: six annual category means normalized by their sum, including All categories; optional log1p mean over all six annual category means; semantic compatibility audit, not physical budget shares
scaling: StandardScaler fit only on training municipalities in each GroupKFold; full descriptive fit on all 1896 municipalities
external_control: Same strict 1248 MO / 70-region mask as frozen Atlas×Radar ablation, 2024 wage/employment, population, market access, coordinates and train-only type dummies; predict log2025, conditional explanatory analysis, not 2023 deployable forecast
metrics: Squared log2025 OOF errors, 2000 paired region-block descriptive bootstrap draws. All primary pairs reported. Silhouette in ONE Q4 canonical-share space frozen on2023 on common400-MO sample; native-space silhouette not cross-arm comparison.
limits: Already viewed panel and external release; frozen before this calculation does not make an independent holdout
Cannot establish welfare, economic truth, causality, or absent historical revisions
Default z-score gives each feature equal coordinate weight; adding volume changes geometry
log1p is fixed-ruble convention and is not invariant to unit conversion; unit-induced label ARI measured separately
Missing and duplicate observations rejected; no zero fill
Ward transfer is explicit nearest fitted training centroid and not native hierarchical prediction
Descriptive conditional bootstrap intervals and sensitivity variants are not a familywise-confirmatory test
